title: WorkstreamRegistrationConformanceCase
description: Fixture envelope for the Workstream Registration v1 conformance corpus (U5, PLAN:341-352). One case per fixture file under tests/contracts/workstream-registration/{valid,invalid,warn,raw,transitions}/. Two case kinds are separated: parsed-value cases carry the decoded JSON document under test in `payload`; raw-byte cases carry base64-encoded raw bytes in `payload_base64` and the decoded bytes are explicitly NOT parsed as JSON documents (PLAN:349) - they are fed to the raw-input guard (KTD11, PLAN:196), which may reject them at any phase. Each case must have exactly one structurally valid expectation entry in expectations.json (gate G2, PLAN:486).

id.description: Stable lowercase-kebab case identifier. Unique across the corpus; the matching manifest entry carries the same id (unambiguous manifest link, gate G2).

kind.description: parsed-value: the document under test is decoded JSON embedded as `payload`. raw-byte: the input is raw bytes carried as base64 in `payload_base64`; the decoded payload is never parsed as a JSON document (PLAN:349).

payload.description: Only with kind=parsed-value. The JSON document under test (any JSON value: a marker, an invalid candidate, or a non-object document). Required by the kind allOf below; forbidden with kind=raw-byte.

payload_base64.description: Only with kind=raw-byte. Standard base64 of the raw input bytes; the decoded bytes may be malformed UTF-8, oversized, duplicate-keyed, over-deep, or otherwise not a JSON document (KTD11, PLAN:196). Length bound covers the 262,145-byte read-cap boundary (349,529 base64 chars) plus oversized cases; the exact byte ceiling is enforced by the raw guard, not this schema.

inputs.description: Optional, transition-case surface (U2, PLAN:374): scenario inputs such as draft, confirmation state, marker/parent presence, target handle, and lock state. The plan leaves this surface open at U5 - U2 defines its vocabulary when the transition fixtures land (U2, PLAN:374-378); the envelope stays closed everywhere else.
